say:1:1641112001:1.text: Hey, have you heard the legend of the midnight ferry at the lake island?
say:1:1641112001:1.source_cn: 听说过湖心岛的夜渡传说吗？
say:1:1641112001:1.male: Hey, have you heard the legend of the midnight ferry at the lake island?
say:1:1641112001:1.female: Hey, have you heard the legend of the midnight ferry at the lake island?

say:2:1641112002:1.text: They say if you visit the pier at the quietest hour of the night, you might see ghostly figures in tattered robes waiting to cross.
say:2:1641112002:1.source_cn: 午夜最寂静的时候，去码头边，偶尔能撞见几个穿着旧法袍的...
say:2:1641112002:1.male: They say if you visit the pier at the quietest hour of the night, you might see ghostly figures in tattered robes waiting to cross.
say:2:1641112002:1.female: They say if you visit the pier at the quietest hour of the night, you might see ghostly figures in tattered robes waiting to cross.

say:3:1641112003:1.text: To board the ferry, you have to take two gold coins, trace a circle around your eyes, and hand them to the boatman.
say:3:1641112003:1.source_cn: 只有掏出两枚金币，沿着双眼蹭一圈，再交给船夫。
say:3:1641112003:1.male: To board the ferry, you have to take two gold coins, trace a circle around your eyes, and hand them to the boatman.
say:3:1641112003:1.female: To board the ferry, you have to take two gold coins, trace a circle around your eyes, and hand them to the boatman.

say:4:1641112004:1.text: Only then will he silently take the oars, and ferry the paid souls into the fog-shrouded island at the lake's heart.
say:4:1641112004:1.source_cn: 他才会面无表情地摆渡，送付钱的亡魂前往被夜雾笼罩的湖心岛。
say:4:1641112004:1.male: Only then will he silently take the oars, and ferry the paid souls into the fog-shrouded island at the lake's heart.
say:4:1641112004:1.female: Only then will he silently take the oars, and ferry the paid souls into the fog-shrouded island at the lake's heart.

say:5:1641112005:1.text: That's one of the better tales from the ghost story club. So, interested in joining?
say:5:1641112005:1.source_cn: 这都是从校园怪谈俱乐部听来的，怎么样，要不要加入俱乐部？
say:5:1641112005:1.male: That's one of the better tales from the ghost story club. So, interested in joining?
say:5:1641112005:1.female: That's one of the better tales from the ghost story club. So, interested in joining?
